nodes.name: React Frontend
nodes.description: Web storefront. Starts the Create Order request when the customer clicks Checkout.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.description: Single entry point. Authenticates requests and routes them to the right service.

nodes.name: User Service
nodes.description: Reads and updates customer information such as profile and shipping address.

nodes.name: Order Service
nodes.description: Coordinates order creation: checks stock, charges payment, then saves the order.

nodes.name: Inventory Service
nodes.description: Checks product availability and reserves stock for an order.

nodes.name: Payment Service
nodes.description: External payment provider. Authorizes and captures the customer's card payment.

nodes.name: Order DB
nodes.description: Stores order records, line items and order status.

steps.message: API Gateway authenticates the request and routes it
Order Service starts creating the order
Inventory Service checks and reserves stock
Stock reserved, back to Order Service
Payment approved, back to Order Service
Order DB saves the new order record
Order saved, Order Service builds the response
